<noinclude>
== Usage ==
'''Subst-only skeleton, not a live template.''' Start a new guide (Field
Procedure) article by creating the page — plain page name, no
namespace/subpage prefix, matching this wiki's flat-title convention, e.g.
<code>[[Unlocking Broo Tarquin]]</code>, not <code>Guide:Unlocking Broo
Tarquin</code> — and, as the very first edit, entering:

<pre>{{subst:New guide page}}</pre>

then saving and filling in the placeholders. Substituting (rather than
transcluding live) means every guide ends up as normal, freely editable
wikitext, same reasoning as {{tl|New engineer page}}.

A guide is a '''procedure''', not a second encyclopedia article. If the
subject already has a Main-namespace reference article (e.g.
[[Broo Tarquin]], [[Multi-Cannon]]), do not re-explain what it is or what
it specialises in here — link to the reference article instead and keep
this page to the actionable checklist (requirements, steps, expected
result). See [[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Creating a Guide]] and
[[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Editorial Policy]].

Do not invent requirements, quantities, or steps — leave a section as "to
be added" until it's been checked against the live game or a reliable
source, per [[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Editorial Policy]].
